central_theorem: The 27-state H(4)/C13:C6 selector is canonically a 3-5-7 harmonic tensor cube, not an ordinary three-qutrit Fourier cube. It contains one genuine C3 qutrit Fourier factor and two qutrit-sized cyclotomic invariant sectors at primes5 and7.
